method: Author self-score on the reviewer's rubric: silhouette and proportions 21/30, signature features 20/25, surface detail and material read 13/20, colour and value 13/15, readability at play distance 9/10. Judged from spring-hound.fidelity-compare.jpg (orthographic EEVEE renders of the low-poly model at the concept's side, front and back angles, framed at the concept's own metres per pixel: side 1.2 m / 855 px, front and back 1.21 m / 875 px) side by side, from close EEVEE crops of the chest, side lens, head and bosses, and from the six in-engine shots in staging/engine, which now bind the brass slots with the manifest tint and render hound-glow through the runtime D11 glow (writeGlowIslands and applyGlowLook from src/enemies/glow.ts). glow-close uses the same 50 degree seat lens as idle for a model this size, so the two frames match. Changes since the 65 review: the cranium is domed (top 1.208 m at y 0.625 against the concept's 1.210) and the jaw is a narrower, deeper wedge; the skull is now aged rather than polished brass, so head-on it reads lit (engine head median V 0.59 against the concept's 0.53) instead of mirroring the dark backdrop; the rose ears fold back over the occiput (top 1.213 m, widest 0.118 m from the midline); the loin is tucked and the keel deepened; the forearm plate bulges at the front and tapers, the gaskin is fuller and the hock has a point. The grille is the single focal light: five 6 mm bars at 25 mm pitch over a flat glow face, and the side lenses are upright slatted ovals (105 mm tall) whose glow sits behind four louvre blades 18 mm deep, so head-on they show brass and from the side the glow shows between the blades. In the engine idle shot the grille's saturated glow is 520 px against about 10 px of visible lens glow. The shoulder and thigh bosses are rubies (COLOR_0 on the gunmetal slot) in polished bezels: engine median about #7B3038 to #884448 (hue 354 to 357, S 0.50 to 0.61, V 0.48 to 0.53) against the concept's #680F23. Engraved gunmetal seams run from the collar to the grille, from the grille ring up to the shoulders and down-outward, and down the shoulder, haunch and forearm plates; each front seam stands 3.7 to 5.1 mm proud of the plate (placed by ray-casting the plate mesh). Rivets ring the collar and the grille. Engine whole-body brass median #846141 (hue 29, S 0.51, V 0.52) against the concept's 24 to 29; gunmetal joints read warm black (#2A1C11). The compare lighting is the fixed warden-matched rig and was not tuned to the score.
gaps: The muzzle is still long and straight in profile: the domed cranium and deeper jaw soften the crocodile read, but the concept's shorter greyhound face with a visible stop is not matched.
Head-on the eye slits read small and dim beside the concept's large glowing eyes, and the face is narrower than the concept's broad lit head.
Glow hue is the project's amber (F08C2C): the engine grille is hue 35 to 42 against the concept's 25, and in the Blender compare the grille and lenses read peach at the GLOW_STRENGTH 0.7 convention.
Ruby saturation falls short of the concept (engine S 0.50 to 0.61 against 0.86): the warm key lights and the gunmetal slot's 0.42 roughness, 0.7 metallic add a pale specular.
The tail hangs to a key at z 0.45 m, where the concept's tail curls back up to a key at about 0.54 m; the far-side legs are not staggered and the rest stance is symmetric.
Legs are still mostly plated cylinders below the forearm and gaskin; paws are simpler than the concept's arched, individually jointed toes.
In the engine idle frame the chest prow's key-light highlight lifts the chest brass to V 0.63 (concept 0.45 to 0.53); the whole-body median is in range.
